text:
sarah: Heads-up: starting ~03:12 UTC we saw a batch of pod restarts in us-west-2 GPU nodepool. Loki search returns logs with "preempted" but no matching trace IDs in APM. Anyone seen this pattern? :eyes:
infra-bot: Alert fired: GPU_Node_Throttled (us-west-2) 03:13 UTC - 12 nodes - avg_throttle=78% :rotating_light:
devon: Can you paste a sample trace_id or request_id?
sarah: Here's the log snippet I pulled:
```
level=error msg="GPU preempted" node=gpu-01 region=us-west-2 job=gpu-driver trace_id=-
```
No trace id, just a dash. Also tried a Kibana search for "trace_id" and came up empty for these events.
ryan: That's odd. Our sidecar should inject X-Trace-ID into stdout. Maybe driver logs are written before the sidecar sees the headers (or the driver drops them). Which driver image are we on?
sarah: Node image: gpu-driver:v2.1.4, nodepool label=g4dn. Cluster autoscaler 1.8. I can repro locally by forcing eviction on a test pod.
marta: Quick Loki query I ran (shortened):
```
{job="gpu-driver", region="us-west-2"} |= "preempted" | line_format "{{.trace_id}} {{.msg}}"
```
Most entries have empty trace_id.
devon: Also seeing increased Grafana SLO alerts for inference-latency-us-west-2 around the same window. Might be retry storms causing throttling -> more retries -> more throttling.
ryan: Two realtime actions: (1) correlate kubelet / ingress logs for the same timestamps to try to extract X-Request-Id, (2) add a short-term driver log hook or fluentd enrichment to inject request_id into driver logs. Also propose tuning the Prometheus alert from 5m to 10m to reduce flapping.
sarah: I tried cross-region Kibana search (us-west-2 -> us-east-1) and found the same request_id present in kube-proxy logs but trace_id still missing in driver output. So tracing is propagated upstream but not seen by the driver logs.
marta: Proposal: add a fluentd pipeline enrichment to grab request_id header and write as log label, plus a tiny trace-forwarder sidecar that enriches driver stdout with trace_id when available. I'll draft the PR.
devon: Cost note: if we blindly scale this pool to absorb retries, monthly GPU spend for that pool could increase ~20%. Prioritize fixing propagation/enrichment vs scaling.
sarah: For triage I collected the time window: 03:12:30 - 03:15:00 UTC. @ryan can you run a grep across node logs for that window and try a join? I'll paste Kibana links after.
ryan: Running command now:
```
kubectl -n infra logs gpu-operator-5f9b -c operator | grep "03:13" -A3
```
Found kubelet entries with X-Request-Id present. I'll join timestamps with driver logs and DM the combined output.
infra-bot: Incident playbook note: added checklist items "driver should emit request_id" and "consider alert duration tuning" (runbook 3.2).
marta: Opening a small PR to add fluentd label enrichment + Grafana panel to show ratio: preempt_events_with_missing_trace_id / total_preempt_events. Also will add a one-line runbook to mute noisy alerts when ratio > 80% to avoid paging.
sarah: If we can't get trace joins within 24h let's add temporary alert suppression for that nodepool to avoid page noise. :fire_extinguisher:
devon: Ack. I'll file an ops/cost ticket with estimates for scale vs engineering fix: TICKET-4512.
sarah: Thanks all — will update thread with Kibana links and the driver log excerpts. Please drop any quick wins here (e.g., fluentd label hotfix) and I'll help deploy. :thumbsup:
